finish.text:
Located the correct email but could NOT confirm it was starred, so reporting failure.

Target found: thread email_1, sender Alice Chen <alice.chen@thornton.com>, subject exactly 'Project Update — Q1 Milestones' (Jul 7, 6:05 PM, label inbox, unread).

Attempts made (UI only):
1. Clicked the star toggle on the inbox list row. The app showed a 'Starred thread — Project Update — Q1 Milestones' toast, but the row's star control kept its unstarred label.
2. Opened the thread and clicked the toolbar control labelled 'Star this thread'. The app again showed a 'Starred' toast.

Verification that failed:
- Starred folder showed 'No messages match this view' on three separate reads (two navigations plus an explicit reload).
- The Starred nav item carried no count badge (count 0) while Inbox correctly showed 11.
- After returning to the inbox, the Alice Chen row rendered identically to before the clicks: still 'Unread thread from Alice Chen: Project Update — Q1 Milestones' with an unstarred star control.

Conclusion: the star controls acknowledge clicks with a toast but the starred state never persists. Since no UI surface confirms the email is starred, success is false. I deliberately did not click the star a third time, because without a reliable state readout another click could toggle an existing star off.
